notes.title: more minor fixes
notes.content:
- fixed an issue where you were given a sword when you totally didn't have a sword
- fixed some issues with judgment in which you are lambasted for things you didn't actually do.

notes.title: Cabin minor softlock fix
notes.content:
- Fixed issue in cabin area where bird would disappear if the area was left.
- Fixed an issue in the well where the character's facing direction would be awkwardly locked until something else changed it

notes.title: WASD Support Added / Difficulty Reduction
notes.content:
- Added WASD support for movement
- Reduced the difficulty required to make a certain person not make a bad decision near a ledge

notes.title: Small bugfix again
notes.content:
- Fixed a small softlock issue in a heavenly area
- Fixed an issue where hide and seek could be triggered by the invisible starter of the event

notes.title: minor bug fixes
notes.content:
- added instructions for deleting text in name selection
- added instructions for keyboard movement

notes.title: Dungeon softlock fix
notes.content: Fixed a small issue causing a potential softlock in a dungeon area.

notes.title: Hell ending fix
notes.content: Fixed a small bug that removed player collision when triggering the "Hell Ending"
